allowed_writes: workflow Skill contracts, canonical runner, resource registry and focused smoke tests
Task, Manifest and project control-plane status

raw query, raw response, full URL, token or historical identifier persistence

run focused fake-transport event-chain smoke and existing Node 4/resource/workflow regression smoke
